interpretation: Updater-side byte variation is present because 6 of 12 identical-treatment clone pairs produced different final skill SHA-256 values.
Evaluator/actor-side variation is directly present because all 6 pairs with byte-identical final skill SHA-256 values still produced nonzero held-out success differences, as large as 4/18.
The frozen design varies updater calls and evaluator calls together, so it cannot estimate their separate variance components or attribute the HOLD to only one component.
The diagnostic does not change the preregistered 12-pair TOST gate and cannot authorize MRW.

call_token_cost_accounting.cost_note: The frozen receipts contain token usage but no billed-price field; no post-hoc monetary estimate is treated as observed cost.
call_token_cost_accounting.incomplete_note: Four evaluator responses reached the 4096 output-token limit without hidden retry; all corresponding rollout endpoints, artifacts, and verifier scores completed, so the frozen runner did not classify them as technical failures.

implementation.evidence: All frozen units completed with content-addressed manifests and no failure artifact; contract/authorization bindings matched.

runtime_infrastructure.evidence: Hosted latency varied and one monitoring MCP call failed, but the locked remote process continued and all endpoints completed without relaunch.

measurement_analysis.evidence: The analyzer used 12 paired streams as independent units, the frozen 1/18 margin, paired TOST, and the predeclared 100000-replicate bootstrap robustness analysis.

protocol_causal_purity.evidence: WIN-A/WIN-B shared the frozen byte-identical winner treatment; MRW was never executed.

scientific_identifiability.evidence: Identical-treatment nuisance variation was not shown equivalent within the fixed practical margin.

scientific_mechanism.evidence: No MRW effectiveness endpoint was executed or observed.

next_authorized_step.future_work: A future attempt requires a new versioned nuisance-control protocol with an independently justified single-variable intervention that isolates evaluator or updater variability before any renewed MRW authorization.

reusable_rule: When an identical-treatment negative control fails equivalence, retain the central mechanism as unknown, block causal execution, and separate directly observed nuisance layers using only outcome-independent or zero-provider diagnostics. Do not relabel the result as implementation failure or rescue it by changing margins, subsets, models, or benchmarks.
